draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Mullayanagiri! At 1,925 metres, this is the highest peak in Karnataka, with a small temple right at the summit.
draft.hungryLine: Head down to Chikmagalur town for a masala dosa. Town Canteen's might even beat Vidyarthi Bhavan in Bengaluru.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Mullayyanagiri summit is right here, and Bababudangiri lies to the north of Chikmagalur.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Sit at the top and take in the Chandra Drona hills, with Seethalayyanagiri peak right next door.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The summit has a police radio relay station, right beside its little temple.

spots.name: Mullayyanagiri
spots.detail: 1 min walk · Karnataka's highest point, with a small temple

spots.name: Bababudangiri
spots.detail: North of Chikmagalur · Where coffee is said to have arrived in India

spots.name: Veera Narayana Temple
spots.detail: About 30 km away in Belavadi · A well known temple

legends.title: Baba Budan's coffee
legends.body: It's believed that Baba Budan introduced coffee to India at Baba Budangiri, north of town. That's why coffee estates cover these hills.

tips.title: Pack a layer.
tips.body: Chikmagalur has a cool climate, around 11 to 20 °C in winter.

tips.title: Plan the B.B.Hills bus.
tips.body: A minibus leaves the private bus stand at 12:30PM and returns by 5PM, so you get about an hour up there.

story.title: Kiriya-Muguli
story.body: Chikmagalur was once known as Kiriya-Muguli.

story.title: Baba Budan's beans
story.body: Baba Budan is believed to have brought coffee to India in the hills just north of the city.

story.title: Coffee and peaks
story.body: Chikmagalur draws visitors for its hill station climate, rainforest and coffee estates, with Karnataka's highest peak on its doorstep.
